Project Setup turns the enforce shape on (MEASURED P10). The disposition is for the truth divergence: one statement of result truth both executors satisfy; merging the executors stays a design option (P2 architecture item). The registry (class B, not a defect) and OPEN-ITEMS OI-113 (Class A, owner decision 'one authoritative execution path') contradict each other: DOC-A4-04. Implementation required: yes, order after GAP-A3-01 and the owner rulings on GAP-A3-03 and GAP-A3-05. Disposition is a proposal for Phase D.
